svg.text: pitch point: where the pitch circles touch (dot)

g.text: The focus slider: a 14-tooth pinion (shifted 0.2) on its rack, module 1
pitch circles (dashed) roll on each other at the pitch point; each flank is the involute of its base circle (dotted), drawn by the end of a string unwound from it
centre distance 7.2 mm (to the pitch line) · 43.98 mm of rack a turn (0.1222 mm a degree) · pressure angle 20°
contact ratio 1.64: the path of contact (4.841 mm, red) over the base pitch (2.952 mm), how many pairs of teeth share the load · backlash 0.15 mm
